purpose: A bounded query-pixel target-ownership component alongside the unresolved V69 semantic-reference/slot contract. This does not redefine full pallet crop/reference visibility or authorize current evaluation.

truth.train_population: All admitted known exact V/E rows of the unchanged V66 four-source TRAIN cache. O and UNKNOWN are excluded, never relabeled E.
truth.known_exact_E_scope: Certified/proxy external support as individually tiered by source; conditional query support, not semantic corner/self gold.
truth.SYNTH: Preserved rendered support facts; original M0/M4 proxy semantics unchanged.
truth.ORIGINAL_YCB: Originally observed target-visible support; original full-only unknown is never E.
truth.CONTROLLED_YCB: Original target-visible pixels covered by independently pasted opaque other-instance RGB; same q/box as original.
truth.PALLOX: Symmetric conditional teacher evidence, empirical depth/RGB consistency; not calibration-certified semantic gold.
truth.state_check: Exact state independently projected from every allowed 6joint bitset and compared to stored exact state; native invalid must be allowed63/stateUNKNOWN.

immutable_source_inputs.GT_pair_tables: Training lineage/supervision only, never model features. TRAIN_CHANGED_PAIR_INDEX.csv alone admits changed pairs to the pair sampler; VAL_PAIR_INDEX.csv cannot enter fitting.

new_multi_query_model_input_contract.deployment_available: One target-associated set of frozen initial-query ROIs from the SAME observed image, their input-only q/box/valid geometry, cached P3/RGB and frozen predicted mask/base evidence. This is a new multi-query-set contract; earlier V68 single-box baseline and V69 three-field whitelist remain unchanged.
new_multi_query_model_input_contract.prototype: For each scored ROI, only OTHER available initial ROIs of the same current target/image supply predicted-mask-weighted P3 prototype. Never filter prototype ROIs by known V/E, GT masks/labels or scores from original/composite twins. Leave-current-ROI-out and empty-support fallback must be explicitly tested in implementation.
new_multi_query_model_input_contract.identity_routing: sample/global/native index may align/order/route observations but are forbidden learned input tokens. No semantic/native-slot identity embedding, reference location/state, object ID, donor ID, original/composite status or filename tokens.
new_multi_query_model_input_contract.pair_separation: Original and composite get distinct prototypes from their own current image. Counterfactual original RGB/features never serve as composite inference evidence.
new_multi_query_model_input_contract.source_deployment_gap: YCB generic source queries were supervised-source samples; SYNTH retains only already included queries. Deployment has initial pallet q8. Target grouping and query-set availability/distribution remain a material assumption.
new_multi_query_model_input_contract.identifiability_limit: If permitted target context cannot distinguish target from foreground, identical inputs can have conflicting ownership/reference labels. No loss or prototype establishes semantic association by itself.

pair_contract.mapping: Immutable TARGETS.jsonl and COMPOSITES.jsonl original_sample_ids; exact same native query, ROI side, target box and original target identity for all8 slots.
pair_contract.non_V: O/UNKNOWN remain unchanged and are audit-only outside this conditional training loss.
pair_contract.split: Original target/RGB, composite, donor RGB/target and YCB scene each remain in one split. PALLOX same-session/pair siblings stay grouped. Shared object categories/render generator are not claimed independent families.
pair_contract.pair_loss_plan_from_root: 32 TRAIN changed pairs per update supply32 original+32 controlled rows, plus32 regular knownVE rows for each YCB domain; SYNTH64 and PALLOX64. Four-source equal BCE +.25 mean softplus(-(z_original-z_controlled)); pair mapping never selected from VAL/current.

selection.population: VAL, same four sources, native-valid known exact V/E only
selection.criterion: Unweighted mean binary NLL within each source, then equal mean over four sources. Every100 updates; earliest strict minimum; fixed2000 update budget. This conditional selector is different from all-class quality gates.
selection.threshold: pV>=.5 fixed; no radius/threshold/crop/architecture/weight selection from VAL/current
selection.ORIGINAL_YCB_caveat: No known E in ORIGINAL_YCB; VE-only precision is trivially1 when V is predicted. Do not use it as the quality precision gate.

fixed_quality_diagnostics.primary_population: ALL native-valid exact-class-known V/E/O, preserving prior fixed cohort. UNKNOWN and invalid retained in separate coverage tables.

known_E_to_binary_nonvisible_recall.wording: pV<.5 is binary nonvisible, never an inferred causal E class on O/unknown.

fixed_quality_diagnostics.knownVE_conditionals: Report separately from all-known V/E/O metrics. Preserve exact denominators, source tiers and O/UNKNOWN prediction distributions.
fixed_quality_diagnostics.comparisons: Frozen same8590-source-query v61 exact-only scores plus existing V65/V66/V67/MobileSAM/SAM21 saved outputs. No invented v61 R2. SAME native valid IDs and GT required.
fixed_quality_diagnostics.authorization: Ten diagnostic conditions do not select another checkpoint and never automatically authorize current inference or prove semantic goal solved.
